description_en: Renews the subscription for a cloud computer pool
description_zh: 为包年包月共享型云电脑续费
kebab_example: aliyun ecd renew-desktop-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-7724r1jitbjzc0000 --period 1 --period-unit Month --auto-pay true --auto-renew false --reseller-owner-uid 1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewDesktopGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions that are supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer pool
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The renewal duration. The valid values of this parameter vary based on the `PeriodUnit` value.

- If you set `PeriodUnit` to `Month`, the valid values are 1, 2, 3, and 6.

- If you set `PeriodUnit` to `Year`, the valid values are 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长。取值范围由参数`PeriodUnit`的值决定。

- `PeriodUnit`为`Month`时，取值范围为：1、2、3、6。

- `PeriodUnit`为`Year`时，取值范围为：1~5。

默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the renewal duration specified by the `Period` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 续费时长的单位，即参数`Period`的单位
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay
